description: This file contains unit tests for the MiracastService plugin, including test cases for various states such as discovery, P2P connection, group formation, and event handling. It also mocks dependencies like WiFi P2P, WPA supplicant, and other network components, and verifies the correct behavior of the plugin in different scenarios.

classes.name: MiracastServiceTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing MiracastService plugin functionalities, which sets up mocks for dependencies and initializes the plugin environment.

classes.name: MiracastServiceEventTest
classes.description: A specialized test fixture extending MiracastServiceTest to handle event-related scenarios and subscription management.
